source_acceptance_required: coverage.json must report source_corpus_ready and integrity-manifest.json must pass against the same coverage and ledger hashes

tasks.question: Does the source inventory account for statements, notes, narrative policies, references and unresolved content?
tasks.expected_evidence: Page/section/span inventory with explicit retained, duplicated, incorporated, unresolved and out-of-scope dispositions
tasks.limit: A retained report is not closure of its incorporated external documents.

tasks.question: Are literal amounts and narrative statements preserved with the right financial context?
tasks.expected_evidence: Source spans, raw literals, entity/perimeter, period, currency, scale, sign, precision and report-specific accounting basis; admissible alternative readings
tasks.limit: Parsed text and accounting-basis keyword checks are not adjudicated semantic labels.

tasks.question: Are fiscal calendars, cumulative interims, revisions and information availability handled correctly?
tasks.expected_evidence: Original and comparative vintages, period intervals, valid and invalid year-to-date subtraction cases, independently evidenced publication times
tasks.limit: No Q4 label for an annual report; no historical as-of test with an unknown availability date.

tasks.question: Do DSL and typed-library inputs preserve the same evidence and alternatives through the shared IR?
tasks.expected_evidence: Identical source packages, registries, semantics and supported operations; matched source-to-IR outputs and explicit rejection cases
tasks.limit: Acquisition does not test compiler or runtime conformance.

tasks.question: Does bounded reconstruction retain jointly admissible histories and reject evidence-incompatible histories?
tasks.expected_evidence: Reviewed finite examples, shared constraints, admitted alternatives, scope exclusions and expected unresolved responses
tasks.limit: Use synthetic truth where latent histories are unknown; do not treat one reconstructed witness as the true or complete real history.

tasks.question: Do explicit scenarios produce coherent conditional journals and financial statements?
tasks.expected_evidence: Supported accounting operations, balanced journals, atomic failures, reconciled statements, preserved scenario/history branches
tasks.limit: Historical forecast accuracy requires a separate plan with frozen availability, matched baselines and uncertainty; it is not tested here.

split_status: not_promoted; freeze for a named task and model only after exposure and duplicate audits
split_rules: All years, language versions, amended filings, mirrors and duplicated tables of one issuer family share the same role.
Apple and Caterpillar have substantive prior development exposure. All other issuers have acquisition/QA exposure; clean unseen-model status is not claimed.
Unilever and Allianz remain supplemental/development-only evidence unless a later task explicitly reassigns them.
The three proposed test families are concentrated in finance/insurance. This is a stress panel, not a balanced population sample or a claim of sector-independent generalisation.
Record future annotation and model exposure; no test promotion based only on this proposed role map.
annotation_order: Establish source-corpus acceptance and freeze hashes.
Prepare literal/context/span records internally without viewing evaluated model predictions.
Preserve source conflicts, multiple readings, missing authority and unresolved package references.
Check arithmetic, dates, units, mappings and proposed accounting consequences internally before any paid review.
Adjudicate only the remaining consequential semantic questions under separately authorised review; preserve each initial reading.
scoring_status: No scores, estimates or labels have been produced. Define task denominators and the uncertainty protocol before evaluation.
critical_errors: wrong entity, unit, currency, time or accounting basis
critical_error_rule: Zero such errors in the declared reviewed conformance set; this finite screen does not certify arbitrary filings.
inference_limit: No model superiority, statistical representativeness, accounting compliance, forecast validity or complete semantic coverage follows from source acceptance.
